jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Equity Research Analyst, AI Platform
jobs.description:
Company Description

About Us

VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together brands including CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, Golf Channel, Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, GolfPass, and SportsEngine.

StockStory, part of CNBC, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We operate like a startup—small team, high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—with the resources and long-term backing of a well-capitalized public company.

Our mission is to help individual investors make better investment decisions by combining institutional-quality equity research, quantitative methods, proprietary data, and AI.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Equity Research Analyst to lead the quantitative research behind our stock-selection models and help build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products.

You will be the primary quantitative research expert on a small, high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side talent, including senior analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with significant autonomy. You will cover investment research methodology, research prototypes, testing standards and model monitoring. Our engineering team will own production infrastructure and scalability, partnering with you to turn successful research into reliable systems.

You will operate as a research partner and lead the quantitative research behind High Quality Stocks, a long-only, factor-based stock-selection strategy designed around an approximately five-year ownership horizon. You will contribute to the development of both a quality framework and a valuation framework designed to identify high-quality businesses whose current prices offer attractive long-term return potential.

The quantitative model drives stock recommendations. Working closely with senior equity analysts, you will translate fundamental investment judgment into measurable hypotheses, systematic signals, ranking models, and decision rules. Analysts help shape and challenge the investment framework; you will own the methodology, empirical validation, and ongoing performance of our models.

What You’ll Do

Lead the quantitative research agenda behind High Quality Stocks.
Improve and refine a quality framework and valuation framework for identifying attractive long-term equity investments.
Partner with senior equity analysts to translate fundamental concepts and investment hypotheses into systematic signals and ranking models.
Design rigorous back tests using point-in-time data, with appropriate controls for look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting, multiple testing, and regime dependence.
Develop machine-learning models and frameworks to help improve performance of the strategy and discover new factors
Evaluate factor performance across sectors, company sizes, market environments, time periods, and portfolio-construction approaches.
Code research prototypes and apply statistical and machine-learning methods where they improve the quality or robustness of the investment process.
Partner with equity data analysts and AI/ML engineers to validate financial data and turn successful research into scalable, production-quality systems.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For:

Minimum of 5 years of quantitative equity research experience, ideally within a long-only asset manager, fundamental quantitative team, long-biased strategy, systematic equity firm, or similar institutional environment.
Direct experience researching long-only or long-biased equity strategies with medium- to long-term investment horizons.
End-to-end ownership of quantitative research, from hypothesis and data construction through back testing, implementation, and performance evaluation.
Strong fundamental equity knowledge, including financial statements, profitability, capital allocation, business quality, and valuation.
Strong knowledge of factor research, statistics, back testing, portfolio construction, and machine learning.
Strong Python skills and experience working with point-in-time fundamentals, estimates, market data, and other financial datasets.
Ability to independently own quantitative research while communicating findings clearly to fundamental investors, engineers, and senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience researching quality, value, profitability, or other fundamental equity factors.
Experience building stock-ranking models, screens, or model portfolios.
Experience applying machine learning to cross-sectional equity research.
Experience with LLM-powered research, financial-document analysis, or AI-assisted investment workflows.
Experience building quantitative research or models used by portfolio managers, equity analysts, or individual investors.

Location & Perks:

Hybrid 3 days in office
At CNBC Headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ, you’ll have access to great perks and amenities:
Sweat it out -- Free onsite fitness center with state-of-the-art equipment, plus daily group classes
Eat up -- Gourmet cafeteria with daily specials plus soup and salad bars
Extras -- Dry cleaning, shoeshine, and sneak peeks
Don’t have a car? No problem! We offer free shuttle transportation to and from multiple locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Hoboken and Jersey City

In addition to these benefits, employees in this group will be joining at a time of meaningful and continued investment in data, technology, and product development, with the opportunity to contribute to a growing team within CNBC that is expected to scale significantly over time, offering meaningful exposure to senior leadership and the ability to influence how the platform evolves.

jobs.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.

We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.

Want to join the leader in AI-powered data security?

Cohesity's International business spans Europe, Emerging Markets, and Asia-Pacific Japan (APJ) — a diverse portfolio of markets at different stages of growth and maturity. As we scale our International GTM motion, we are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Sr. International Project Manager to design and drive the execution of a set of key strategic projects aligned to our International sales plays and GTM priorities.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role that sits at the heart of International leadership. You will work closely with regional sales, channel, technical, finance, and enablement teams, as well as Corporate Strategy, Operations, and PMO functions, to build a cohesive International program that translates our key sales strategies into measurable field-level results.

How You'll Spend Your Time Here

Own and drive the International Program Management framework, ensuring it is structured, visible, and actionable from leadership to District Manager level.
Define program milestones, workstreams, and success metrics in partnership with International leadership and Corporate PMO.
Maintain a consolidated International project plan that integrates inputs from Europe, Emerging, and APJ, with clear ownership, timelines, and status.
Establish a regular operating rhythm — including program reviews, steering
Partner with International Sales leadership, Enablement, Ops and Marketing to translate corporate sales plays into International-relevant, field-ready programs.
Drive the localisation and sequencing of sales plays across Europe, Emerging, and APJ, ensuring they are adapted as required.
Drive structured feedback loops from Sales, Channel, Technical, Ops and Finance leads, incorporating ground-level insights into project design and iteration.
Own end-to-end management of the International Cyber Up Program, acting as the primary point of accountability across Europe, Emerging, and APJ.
Track program progress against milestones and key metrics, maintaining a clear, up-to-date view for International leadership and relevant stakeholders.
Embed the program with regional and cross-functional teams — Sales, Channel, Enablement, and Ops — ensuring consistent adoption and alignment with local priorities.
Review program results on a regular cadence, capturing insights and lessons learned to inform iteration and drive continuous improvement.

WE'D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:

Driver capabilities; sets pace and pushes projects to outcomes, rather than administering a process.
Strong GTM/sales operations background with the standing to influence and hold accountable an International SVP, Regional VPs, and field leadership.
Takes personal accountability for program outcomes and field results, not just for tracking and reporting on them.
Makes judgment calls with incomplete information, resolves blockers directly, and escalates only when a decision genuinely sits above their authority.
Extensive track record of standing up program structures and operating rhythms from scratch, not just running an existing framework.
Experience driving alignment across Europe, Emerging Markets, and APJ, where priorities and working styles differ.
Turns KPIs and dashboards into clear recommendations and decisions, rather than producing reporting for its own sake.
Proactively surfaces risk and opportunity early and acts on it, rather than waiting for direction.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Fasset

Fasset is building the ownership bank: real assets (gold, backed dollars, global markets) on regulated rails across the Gulf, South Asia, and Southeast Asia. $100M+ raised, 2M+ users.

About the Role

Seven events in six countries, five different growth workstreams, and several open roles to fill, all with hard deadlines through December. This role exists to make sure all of it actually happens on time: venues get booked, vendors get paid, decisions get made and followed through, and nothing falls through the cracks. You'll have real ownership day to day — picking vendors, planning travel, running the recurring team meetings — while bigger calls (big spend, signing contracts, anything public-facing) go through your manager for approval. It's a hands-on, high-trust role: by the end of the year you'll have delivered a full slate of international events and built the systems that keep a fast-moving growth team organized, with a clear path afterward into a bigger role in events, growth, or operations.

Responsibilities

Run the operating cadence — weekly growth and studio reviews, a monthly scorecard, and per-stop go/no-go calls. Circulate written inputs the day before, log decisions and owners after, and chase follow-through while there's still time to fix it.
Own Buildathon production end to end — seven stops from September to December, covering venue, vendors, permits, budget, run of show, guest list, travel, on-site delivery, and close-out.
Manage vendors and suppliers — sourcing, negotiating, contracting, paying on time, and holding them to spec across venues, AV, production, research, and the freelance creative bench.
Maintain programme tracking — one place where every commitment across the five streams lives with an owner and a date, and you're accountable for the tracker being true.
Provide executive enablement — roughly one day a week of calendar and inbox triage, travel, briefing packs before every meeting that matters, and holding threads that would otherwise drop.
Keep hiring operations moving — scheduling, candidate experience, and no candidate waiting a week for a reply.

Requirements

Has produced live events end to end, in more than one country — booked the venue, argued with the AV supplier, and fixed the thing that broke ninety minutes before doors. This is the requirement that gets probed hardest in interview.
Travel ready: roughly five to six weeks in transit between September and December across the UAE, Turkey, Pakistan, Japan, the UK, and the US, with existing visa-free access or valid multi-entry visas (or the ability to obtain them without delaying a booking). Trips are sometimes confirmed at two weeks' notice.
Works well when it's messy — can take a half-formed instruction and come back with a plan, and hold a dozen open threads while building the system that holds them.
Comfortable that roughly a day a week is calendar, inbox, travel, and expenses — a capped but permanent share of the role.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to manage and analyze large amounts of information, typically technical or scientific in nature, independently with minimal supervision.

Stanford University is one of the world’s most renowned universities. Sitting in the heart of the San Francisco Bay Area among the valley’s most progressive companies.

You will be working with an unparalleled leading-edge community of faculty and staff that are fundamentally changing the world of health care. You will have the opportunity to influence and drive change with your innovative ideas, the ability to make a difference and participate in human advancements. Our culture is fast-paced, energetic, and growing all of the time.

We offer a variety of benefits beyond traditional medical, dental, retirement, and savings options:

Events and program for children, sports camps, tuition options
World-class intellectual stimulation through learning and development classes, workshops, and onsite conferences from leading-edge speakers and faculty
Work/life and family-friendly policies and reimbursement
Participation in Stanford’s social responsibility and sustainable programs for a better world
A vibrant university culture that values the uniqueness of each individual

We are seeking candidates who are progressive thinkers, see challenges as simply problems to solve, and have the spirit and energy to change the world.

About The Department Of Pathology

The Department of Pathology at Stanford School of Medicine, one of its founding departments, stands as a leader among its peers nationwide. Our preeminent faculty spans from emerging leaders to highly accomplished physicians and scientists, including a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy. Our mission is to improve the diagnosis, treatment, and basic understanding of the human disease. This is done through discovery (research), education, and clinical care. Comprised of extraordinary faculty and staff, our mission is to improve the ability to diagnose, treat and understand the origin and

manifestation of human disease, and to care for those who have or are at risk to develop disease. We accomplish this through our clinical services (in all fields of anatomic and clinical pathology, including molecular and genomic pathology, histocompatibility testing and transfusion medicine) and be research (which includes basic, translational and clinical research into the origins and manifestations of disease, including efforts to improve disease prediction and prevention as part of the goal of achieving precision medicine and health), and also by educating future leaders in pathology and related fields. Everything we do is to achieve the goals of providing the highest quality of clinical services to the patients for whom we passionately care, to advance our ability to understand, diagnose, monitor and ultimately to cure disease or to prevent or delay its occurrence, and to provide outstanding education and career development opportunities to those who share these goals.

For more information about the department visit http://pathology.stanford.edu/

About The Lab

The Research Data Analyst 2 will be working within the Stanford Pathology EMERALD (Enhancing Medical Excellence via Research in Advanced Laboratory Diagnostics) Program. EMERALD is engaged in diagnostics research and novel test development with the goal of rapid deployment in the clinical laboratories.

About The Position

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to join our comprehensive cancer genomics program. The RDA2 will be involved in the development and application of bioinformatic tools for the analysis of oncology-related sequencing data including, but not limited to, whole exome, whole genome, and whole transcriptome data from solid tumor and hematopoietic cell malignancies. The RDA2 will also support the implementation of distributed pipeline architectures for medical NGS data analysis. The emphasis is on clinical grade quality, scalability and maintainability in an in-house cluster or cloud environment.

Duties Include

Prioritize and extract data from a variety of sources such as notes, survey results, medical reports, and laboratory data, and maintain its accuracy and completeness.
Determine additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based upon data in the database. Oversee and monitor regulatory compliance for utilization of the data.
Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and eliminate root cause for data problems or justify solutions to be implemented by others.
Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.
Analyze sequencing data generated as part of the comprehensive cancer genomics program.
- Other duties may also be assigned

Rarely writing by hand.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:

Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.

What We're Looking For:

7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have:

Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.

How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:

Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.

This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:

The expected base pay for this role is between $153,000 - $186,000. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Exact compensation will be discussed during the interview process and tailored to the candidate's qualifications.

Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity package
Competitive paid time off in addition to holiday time off
A variety of healthcare insurance plans to give you the best care for your needs
401K matching above the industry standard
Professional Development Reimbursement Program

Work Authorization

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.

Cultivate strong client relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and technical excellence.
Develop scopes of work, project budgets, work breakdown structures, and schedules, ensuring alignment with client expectations and internal standards.
Manage project teams, monitor budgets and schedules, delegate tasks effectively, and mentor junior staff to support their technical and professional growth.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in civil, geotechnical, or geological engineering; Master’s degree strongly preferred.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in California required; GE license or ability to obtain one is desired.
Progressive geotechnical engineering experience demonstrating increasing responsibility in subsurface investigations, geotechnical analysis, foundation design, earth retention systems, slope stability, ground improvement, or related areas.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining high standards of quality and safety. PMP Certification is a plus.

Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM)
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the outcome of programs that span both the physical hardware platform and the embedded software that runs on it. Accountability extends beyond schedule to the product itself: delivered on time, at target cost, with the performance that differentiates it, and manufacturable at scale. The role sits at the intersection of hardware engineering, embedded and firmware development, manufacturing, and product, and carries accountability for what those teams collectively deliver without direct authority over any of them.

The work is genuinely cross-disciplinary: hardware bring-up issues affect firmware timelines, embedded software readiness affects qualification schedules, and a change on one side of that boundary creates hidden risk on the other. The role requires enough technical depth to understand both halves of that system, to recognize a developing failure mode before it is reported, and to drive the resulting decision through to a conclusion.

This is a senior-level role. You will be expected to bring structure to ambiguity, make judgment calls on incomplete information, and examine plans and readiness claims closely: whether a schedule carries realistic slack, whether test coverage assumes the first build works, whether a supplier commitment has been confirmed. Where a plan does not hold up, we expect you to say so and to implement corrective actions.

Responsibilities

End-to-End Program Ownership

Own the program end to end, from requirements through hardware bring-up, embedded software integration, qualification, manufacturing readiness, customer deployment, and post-launch review. Accountability extends to four outcomes: schedule, product cost, the performance that differentiates the product, and manufacturability at volume
Drive hardware engineering, embedded and firmware engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and product toward a single committed plan, holding these teams to their commitments without direct authority over any of them
Partner directly with hardware and embedded/firmware engineers on architecture trade-offs, integration test planning, and qualification strategy, with enough understanding of the work to question assumptions behind it
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule, critical path, dependencies, and resource plan across hardware and embedded software workstreams, and track product cost against target alongside schedule
Own the risk process end to end, covering identification, ownership, mitigation plans, and closure timelines, with particular attention to risks that cross the hardware and software boundary. Identify developing failure modes early, and escalate where a mitigation is not working, in time for the program to respond
Review plans and readiness claims for the evidence behind them, and withhold gate approval where that evidence is not present
Engage supply chain and manufacturing during design so that product cost and manufacturability are addressed alongside schedule and performance, rather than at handoff

Decision Making & Communication

Deliver weekly internal status updates and monthly program reports (to leadership and customers) covering milestone and schedule performance, critical path status, cost against target, key accomplishments, and risk and issue summaries, with a recommended course of action where the program is off plan
Translate deep technical detail into clear, decision-ready updates for engineering leadership and executives, including root cause, impact, recovery plan, and the decision required
Build and maintain executive-ready dashboards and reporting tools (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) that keep a complex, multi-workstream program legible to everyone involved
Keep all program documentation — schedules, plans, reports, action logs — current and accessible

Customer Engagement

Partner closely with customers and product managers to clarify requirements, review progress, manage expectations, and resolve escalations
Facilitate milestone reviews, demonstrations, and acceptance activities throughout the delivery lifecycle

Process & Governance

Establish and maintain program governance — milestone reviews, risk management, issue escalation, and change control
Drive continuous improvement of program processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms, promoting execution consistency across multiple concurrent programs
Support portfolio-level planning, resource prioritization, and cross-program coordination as needed

Qualifications

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have 8 or more years of technical program management experience, including meaningful, hands-on experience with both hardware platform development and the embedded software or firmware running on that hardware
Have genuine technical depth — comfortable in a hardware bring-up or schematic review, and equally comfortable in a conversation about firmware architecture, RTOS constraints, or embedded integration testing
Have delivered a product to a cost target and can describe the trade-offs it required
Have a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional programs to completion through teams you do not manage
Can take a loosely scoped, ambiguous problem and turn it into a concrete plan with clear owners and milestones
Are rigorous about detail, and check the evidence behind a date, a readiness claim, or a dependency rather than accepting it as reported
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can translate between hardware engineers, embedded software engineers, and executive stakeholders without losing accuracy in either direction
Hold a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience (advanced degree preferred)
Own risk and dependency management across the full hardware and software development lifecycle, including manufacturing readiness and validation
Have experience coordinating across R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain organizations
Are comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and aggressive schedules
Are proficient with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, or similar program management tools
PMP, Scrum/Agile certification, or equivalent is a plus, not a requirement

Preferred Qualifications

Strong customer-facing leadership experience, including executive-level communication and escalation management
Experience in high-technology industries (e.g., wireless, satellite, networking, test & measurement)
Experience leading complex hardware/software customer programs

Success in This Role Looks Like

The product ships on the committed date, at or below target cost, and meets the performance specifications that differentiate it. Customer milestones and contractual commitments are met
The product is manufacturable at volume at launch, with yield and process capability demonstrated
Risks and issues are identified early and driven to closure
Cross-functional teams work to a single agreed plan, and schedule or cost deviations are raised by the program manager early enough to act on
Program documentation and reporting are accurate, current, and accessible
Predictable, no-surprise program execution

Loveland, CO Pay Range: MIN $138,750.00 - MAX $231,250.00

Colorado Springs, CO Pay Range: MIN $138,750.00 - MAX $231,250.00

The Behavioral Health Expansion Branch (BHEB) within the Community Services Division (CSD) administers the Behavioral Health Continuum Infrastructure Program (BHCIP) grant and the Behavioral Health Infrastructure Bond Act of 2024 (BHIBA). BHCIP provides competitive grants to qualified entities to construct, acquire and rehabilitate real estate assets, or to invest in infrastructure, for the expansion of community continuum of behavioral health treatment resources. BHIBA is a general obligation bond to develop an array of behavioral health treatment, residential care settings, and supportive housing to help provide appropriate care facilities for Californians experiencing mental health conditions and substance use disorders.

Under direction of the Supervisor I, the Analyst II is responsible for developing, operationalize, and administering tasks related to BHCIP and BHIBA. The Analyst II is responsible for the implementation, administration, oversight, and evaluation of the BHCIP and BHIBA. Duties may include performance oversight and monitoring of contractors and grant-funded programs to determine compliance with project, contract, plan, and agreement requirements, terms, conditions, and services. Duties also consist of generating policies and procedures, as well as providing technical assistance, training and administrative support, as needed.

This position is subject to the Department's Conflict of Interest Code and filing a Statement of Economic Interests (Form 700) when assuming office, annually while in office, and upon leaving office.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Business Analyst – AVP in Risk Technology. At Barclays, our vision is clear – to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. You will play a critical role in translating strategic objectives and product vision into scalable technology solutions that deliver measurable value to users and the bank. Your responsibilities include gathering and documenting requirements, creating user stories, process flows, and detailed specifications, and conducting process mapping, gap analysis, and impact assessments to support platform development. In this role, you will collaborate closely with business users and engineering teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and expectations, while leading User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including test planning, execution, and coordination across stakeholders. In partnership with Product Management, the role will help shape product roadmaps, priorities, and KPIs, ensuring successful delivery of strategic initiatives and continuous platform improvement.

To be successful as a Senior Business Analyst - AVP, you should have:

Good understanding of market and credit risk concepts, including Value at Risk (VaR), risk sensitivities, P&L attribution, stress testing, and FRTB framework
Considerable SQL or Python skills for data analysis, data validation, reporting, and business requirements development
Proven ability to perform requirements elicitation & documentation, process mapping, gap analysis, and cross-functional stakeholder management while bridging communication between risk, quants, and technical teams
Experience working with Jira, Confluence, and similar tools for requirements management, documentation, and project tracking
Working knowledge of Agile and SAFe Agile delivery frameworks, including user story creation, backlog management, and sprint execution

Other Highly Valued Skills Include

Ability to analyze data models, understand entity relationships, and assess data lineage and dependencies
Experience working with APIs, batch and real-time data pipelines, and system integration architectures
Knowledge of pricing and valuation methodologies across multiple asset classes, including rates, credit, and equities
Good understanding of User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing methodologies, and quality assurance practices for technology platforms
Familiarity with Risk Management (RM), Front Office (FO), and Quantitative Analytics (QA) processes and their use of risk and pricing data

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. At the heart of Defining Possible is our commitment to missions. We’re looking for innovators who can help us keep building on our wide portfolio of secure, affordable, integrated, and multi-domain systems and technologies that fuel those missions. By joining in our shared mission, we will support yours by expanding your personal network and developing skills, whether you are new to the field or an industry thought leader. At Northrop Grumman, you will have the resources, support, and team to do some of the best work of your career.

Northrop Grumman’s Corporate Sector's Chief Information & Digital Office (CIDO) is seeking a Principal Cyber Intelligence Analyst
to support its CISO & Global Cybersecurity organization’s Cybersecurity Operations Center. The team is looking to add a versatile, experienced, highly motivated analyst and tool builder to our world-class team of cyber defensive operators. Adaptability, creativity, commitment to mission, self-direction, and strong written/verbal communications skills are essential. The desired candidate should be high-performing SOC analyst wishing for greater influence in automating away alert fatigue and/or a cyber systems engineer with intense curiosity about the front-line of cyber defense and incident response.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor, investigate, and respond to cyber threat alerts on unclassified and classified networks.
Create and tune cyber threat detection rules in a variety of platforms.
Conceptualize, build and integrate tools that improve efficacy of defensive cyber operations.
Collaborate with cyber, technical, and non-technical teams to navigate the complexities of incident response and DevSecOps in organic networks, restricted environments, and an evolving mission landscape.

Basic Qualifications

8 years of relevant experience with an Associates in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Network Defense, Information Systems, Digital Forensics, or related field; 5 Years with Bachelors; 3 Years with Masters; 1 Year with PhD.
Candidates must have a current U.S. Government Top Secret level security clearance, to include SCI access and a recent Polygraph [adjudicated within the last 5 years], in order to be considered.
Fluency in offensive cyber Tactics, Techniques, & Procedures (TTPs).
A strong foundation in defensive cyber operations in a team atmosphere.
Blue Team analytic mindset and experience: incident triage, threat hunting, alert handling.
Proven Dev/Sec/Ops competency – able to write code, optimize SIEM queries, engineer integrations, and upskill in new technologies as needed.

Embed the program with regional and cross-functional teams — Sales, Channel, Enablement, and Ops — ensuring consistent adoption and alignment with local priorities.

Driver capabilities; sets pace and pushes projects to outcomes, rather than administering a process.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Fasset

Fasset is building the ownership bank: real assets (gold, backed dollars, global markets) on regulated rails across the Gulf, South Asia, and Southeast Asia. $100M+ raised, 2M+ users.

About the Role

Seven events in six countries, five different growth workstreams, and several open roles to fill, all with hard deadlines through December. This role exists to make sure all of it actually happens on time: venues get booked, vendors get paid, decisions get made and followed through, and nothing falls through the cracks. You'll have real ownership day to day — picking vendors, planning travel, running the recurring team meetings — while bigger calls (big spend, signing contracts, anything public-facing) go through your manager for approval. It's a hands-on, high-trust role: by the end of the year you'll have delivered a full slate of international events and built the systems that keep a fast-moving growth team organized, with a clear path afterward into a bigger role in events, growth, or operations.

Responsibilities

Run the operating cadence — weekly growth and studio reviews, a monthly scorecard, and per-stop go/no-go calls. Circulate written inputs the day before, log decisions and owners after, and chase follow-through while there's still time to fix it.
Own Buildathon production end to end — seven stops from September to December, covering venue, vendors, permits, budget, run of show, guest list, travel, on-site delivery, and close-out.
Manage vendors and suppliers — sourcing, negotiating, contracting, paying on time, and holding them to spec across venues, AV, production, research, and the freelance creative bench.
Maintain programme tracking — one place where every commitment across the five streams lives with an owner and a date, and you're accountable for the tracker being true.
Provide executive enablement — roughly one day a week of calendar and inbox triage, travel, briefing packs before every meeting that matters, and holding threads that would otherwise drop.
Keep hiring operations moving — scheduling, candidate experience, and no candidate waiting a week for a reply.

Requirements

Has produced live events end to end, in more than one country — booked the venue, argued with the AV supplier, and fixed the thing that broke ninety minutes before doors. This is the requirement that gets probed hardest in interview.
Travel ready: roughly five to six weeks in transit between September and December across the UAE, Turkey, Pakistan, Japan, the UK, and the US, with existing visa-free access or valid multi-entry visas (or the ability to obtain them without delaying a booking). Trips are sometimes confirmed at two weeks' notice.
Works well when it's messy — can take a half-formed instruction and come back with a plan, and hold a dozen open threads while building the system that holds them.
Comfortable that roughly a day a week is calendar, inbox, travel, and expenses — a capped but permanent share of the role.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to manage and analyze large amounts of information, typically technical or scientific in nature, independently with minimal supervision.

Stanford University is one of the world’s most renowned universities. Sitting in the heart of the San Francisco Bay Area among the valley’s most progressive companies.

You will be working with an unparalleled leading-edge community of faculty and staff that are fundamentally changing the world of health care. You will have the opportunity to influence and drive change with your innovative ideas, the ability to make a difference and participate in human advancements. Our culture is fast-paced, energetic, and growing all of the time.

We offer a variety of benefits beyond traditional medical, dental, retirement, and savings options:

Events and program for children, sports camps, tuition options
World-class intellectual stimulation through learning and development classes, workshops, and onsite conferences from leading-edge speakers and faculty
Work/life and family-friendly policies and reimbursement
Participation in Stanford’s social responsibility and sustainable programs for a better world
A vibrant university culture that values the uniqueness of each individual

We are seeking candidates who are progressive thinkers, see challenges as simply problems to solve, and have the spirit and energy to change the world.

About The Department Of Pathology

The Department of Pathology at Stanford School of Medicine, one of its founding departments, stands as a leader among its peers nationwide. Our preeminent faculty spans from emerging leaders to highly accomplished physicians and scientists, including a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy. Our mission is to improve the diagnosis, treatment, and basic understanding of the human disease. This is done through discovery (research), education, and clinical care. Comprised of extraordinary faculty and staff, our mission is to improve the ability to diagnose, treat and understand the origin and

manifestation of human disease, and to care for those who have or are at risk to develop disease. We accomplish this through our clinical services (in all fields of anatomic and clinical pathology, including molecular and genomic pathology, histocompatibility testing and transfusion medicine) and be research (which includes basic, translational and clinical research into the origins and manifestations of disease, including efforts to improve disease prediction and prevention as part of the goal of achieving precision medicine and health), and also by educating future leaders in pathology and related fields. Everything we do is to achieve the goals of providing the highest quality of clinical services to the patients for whom we passionately care, to advance our ability to understand, diagnose, monitor and ultimately to cure disease or to prevent or delay its occurrence, and to provide outstanding education and career development opportunities to those who share these goals.

For more information about the department visit http://pathology.stanford.edu/

About The Lab

The Research Data Analyst 2 will be working within the Stanford Pathology EMERALD (Enhancing Medical Excellence via Research in Advanced Laboratory Diagnostics) Program. EMERALD is engaged in diagnostics research and novel test development with the goal of rapid deployment in the clinical laboratories.

About The Position

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to join our comprehensive cancer genomics program. The RDA2 will be involved in the development and application of bioinformatic tools for the analysis of oncology-related sequencing data including, but not limited to, whole exome, whole genome, and whole transcriptome data from solid tumor and hematopoietic cell malignancies. The RDA2 will also support the implementation of distributed pipeline architectures for medical NGS data analysis. The emphasis is on clinical grade quality, scalability and maintainability in an in-house cluster or cloud environment.

Duties Include

Prioritize and extract data from a variety of sources such as notes, survey results, medical reports, and laboratory data, and maintain its accuracy and completeness.
Determine additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based upon data in the database. Oversee and monitor regulatory compliance for utilization of the data.
Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and eliminate root cause for data problems or justify solutions to be implemented by others.
Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.
Analyze sequencing data generated as part of the comprehensive cancer genomics program.
- Other duties may also be assigned

Physical Requirements*:

Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity.
Occasionally use a telephone.
Rarely writing by hand.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
new_jobs.description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:

Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.

What We're Looking For:

7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have:

Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.

How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:

Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.

This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:

The expected base pay for this role is between $153,000 - $186,000. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Exact compensation will be discussed during the interview process and tailored to the candidate's qualifications.

Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity package
Competitive paid time off in addition to holiday time off
A variety of healthcare insurance plans to give you the best care for your needs
401K matching above the industry standard
Professional Development Reimbursement Program

Work Authorization

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.

Slickdeals is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other protected status. Slickdeals will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with the "Ban the Box" legislation. We may access publicly available information as part of your application.

Slickdeals participates in E-Verify. For more information, please refer to E-Verify Participation and Right to Work.

Slickdeals does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies and is not responsible for related fees.
